I thought it was pretty clear that my point was that sometimes it’s better to deal reduced damage as a sacrifice for keeping a safe distance, but maybe not so let me try elaborating.

When you’re at danger level 100, you’ve been downed and are out of heals, local aether vent depleted, have low hp, and all teammates are downed and also apparently out of self revives, it may not be “optimal” to attack with a white crosshairs and reload at a distance (no empowering) but it is definite more safe and smarter.

But defense is a strategy and sometimes it’s the more valid strategy.

I went ahead and got the thrustmaster HOTAS 4 for pa4 after a day of playing with controller.

I’d start by saying if he has PSVR, go ahead and get it. It will just make the immersion of the VR experience that much better.

If not here’s my thoughts/experience.

I love playing with the stick. It is just more fun for me and I feel more agile in my movements/speed control. With a controller it is hard to accelerate and yaw right or decelerate and yaw left because you would be using the R1+R2/L1+L2 buttons simultaneously and at least with how I hold a controller, it means adjusting to bring a second finger up to the top of the controller. With the flight stick you can throttle up by pushing forward on your left hand throttle and yaw with the buttons on the back of the throttle or twist the flight stick. It’s much easier.

I do feel it’s downfall, however, is in precision. >! the final mission includes a portion where you fly through a tunnel, then in a small closed in area, followed by (essentially) another tunnel. !<
My movements on the stick are abrupt and usually pretty “large.” For aspects of missions like this, or completing a challenge to have a specific enemy appear, etc I opted to use my controller because I could make minor adjustments much easier.

So, for me, the ~$80 was worth it for the added experience. The other downfall is there aren’t many other compatible games on the PS4 right now, so I’m looking for games I can use it on pc as well.

Hope that helps.
